data.title: Vela By Omniyat
data.about:
Vela by Omniyat is a groundbreaking residential development that pushes the boundaries of luxury living. With its extraordinary collection of residences, including the 5-bedroom sky palace, 4-bedroom penthouses, and 3 to 4-bedroom sky and marina residences, this innovative project offers 38 exclusive homes within a magnificent 30-floor high-rise building.

Designed by the renowned Foster & Partners, the Vela penthouses are cutting-edge structures that blend elegance with a serene ambience effortlessly. As the only water-facing project in Marasi Bay, Vela boasts a striking presence that is truly unparalleled. Step inside, and you’ll be greeted by interiors that exude a remarkable atmosphere, influenced by the exquisite Lana Residences designed by Gilles & Boissier.

Vela Residences effortlessly combines class, comfort, and a high standard of living, free from any compromises. Enjoy unobstructed vistas of the Dubai Canal, the iconic Burj Khalifa, and the city’s captivating skyline. Indulge in the array of recreational options provided by The Dorchester Collection’s facilities, including valet services, round-the-clock security, an elegant main lobby, marina facilities, and a VIP lobby. At Vela by Omniyat, a new standard of luxury living is redefined, where impeccable design, unrivalled amenities, and breathtaking surroundings come together seamlessly.

location_tile.title: Welcome to a place that combines the finest of both worlds.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Enjoy the peacefulness of quiet surroundings while knowing that the energy of the vibrant city is within reach. Mudon Al Ranim 7 invites you to experience a lifestyle that seamlessly blends convenience and tranquilly, from easy commuting to an array of amenities. Mudon Al Ranim 7 is the epitome of convenience and connectivity, conveniently placed within Dubai’s exclusive Mudon neighbourhood. Experience easy access to every aspect of the city, offering a life filled with unrivalled opportunities.

This is more than just a location – it’s a gateway to boundless possibilities. Mudon Al Ranim 7 invites you to immerse yourself in a harmonious lifestyle where convenience and tranquillity coexist. Discover a world where your aspirations become a reality, where you can savour the peace of your surroundings while remaining effortlessly connected to the city’s dynamic energy.
